Anita: Quick postmortem follow-up  we need clear owners for quota/backstop, scheduler tuning, headroom sims, and alerting. Reply with owner + ETA.

Raj: Ill own quota/backstop. Plan: temp burst-credit namespace + quota uplift request for critical services. PR by Thu 11:00 PT.

Mei: Ill do scheduler tuning + canary. Staging canary Wed 22:00 PT; prod window Thu 02:00 PT if green.

Sam: Headroom modelling here. Ill replay 6 weeks and deliver heatmap + safety multiplier. ETA Tue EOD.

Carlos: Ill add telemetry and alerts: consecutive autoscaler throttles >3 in 10m, and a composite rule for cache-miss + scale burst. Draft alert by Fri.

Maya: Ill update the runbook and add the compact triage checklist (quota -> autoscaler events -> node fragmentation -> cache warm). Mon AM.

infra-bot: Created tracker INC-4999: "gpu-autoscale-followups" assigned to Raj, Mei, Sam, Carlos, Maya. Link: https://tracker.internal/INC-4999. Weekly check-in Mon 09:00 PT.

Anita: Thanks everyone  Ill run weekly rollups until INC-4999 is closed. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
